candidate.title: Drop-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned single-row Drop-Seq poster schematic: cell suspension and uniquely barcoded primer beads are co-encapsulated in droplets, released mRNA hybridizes to bead oligo(dT), RNA-bearing beads are recovered and pooled, cDNA is synthesized and amplified, and the resulting DNA library is sequenced. The broad crop also shows separate CLaP, CytoSeq and Hi-SCL catalogue rows, which are context rather than branches of the assigned target. The card source_method_labels and grouped_source_row=false select Drop-Seq, corroborated by the collection page heading and matching schematic caption. The single-cell/poly(A)-RNA icon identifies the biological target; the oligo/bead drawings describe input materials rather than RNA isolation or bead manufacture. The primary Drop-Seq paper resolves the bead, cDNA and readout interfaces within the depicted blocks.

states.label: Drop-Seq amplified mRNA-derived cDNA library

Template switching supplies a downstream PCR handle; the bead primer supplies the original common handle. Library finishing is kept inside the broad depicted preparation interface.

operations.description: Lyse the compartmentalized cell and hybridize its released mRNA to the companion bead primers; the output is bead-associated RNA still in the original droplets.
operations.mechanism: Oligo(dT)-poly(A) hybridization, as indicated by the RNA key and bead legend.
operations.information_effect: Capture associates mRNA templates with the bead carrying cell and molecular labels; reverse transcription is a later block.

operations.label: Pool all beads from droplets

operations.information_effect: Compartments no longer separate the captured transcriptomes; the retained bead/primer association carries their provenance.

operations.label: cDNA synthesis and amplification
operations.description: Convert the pooled bead-associated RNA templates into cDNA and amplify their tagged DNA representation in the broad block shown. The primary-supported 3' library finishing interface remains within this block rather than becoming a reconstructed series of unshown operations.
operations.mechanism: Bead-attached primers initiate reverse transcription; template switching adds a downstream PCR handle, followed by amplification and preparation of the supported 3' cDNA library.
operations.information_effect: Bead-primer extension creates cDNA with covalently linked cell barcode and UMI, converting the captured RNA association into a stable DNA representation. The original common primer handle is retained; template switching adds a further handle. The resulting 3' library supports transcript counting by cell rather than complete transcript reconstruction.

method_scopes.rationale: The single assigned Drop-Seq source row includes all five local operations: co-encapsulation of cells and tagged beads, in-droplet lysis/capture, recovered bead pooling, cDNA synthesis/amplification, and sequencing. Source-row provenance and the matching collection heading/caption establish this scope. CLaP, CytoSeq and Hi-SCL appear as independently labeled neighboring rows without a connecting route or alternative branch into Drop-Seq. They are not target workflows of this card, so their records and the five scope-induced Unknowns from the previous candidate are removed. Drop-seq and Drop-Seq are capitalization variants of this same named implementation in the inspected sources. The Macosko full text directly supports the assigned architecture; no research blocker remains at schematic scope.
